title: Liquidated Damages Credit on a Late Retrofit Project
content:
# Liquidated Damages Credit on a Late Retrofit Project

Where a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects in a class carrying a schedule guarantee is handed over later than the guarantee allows, liquidated damages are credited to the owner on that project's account.

## What the credit does

The credit is put on the project's running account as a single line dated the day it is made and marked as damages for lateness, and the amount owed on the project falls by the same amount. The owner sees the credit on the project statement and a lower project balance.

## Making the credit

The credit is made by the agent with the tool `credit_liquidated_damages_732a84c1`, a hidden tool that is unlocked and then called by the agent. One call puts one liquidated damages credit on one project.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | The reference number of the replacement or retrofit project the credit is put on | The project reference as it stands in the project lookup for this owner |
| `damages_credit_usd` | The money amount of the credit | A decimal number of USD, rounded half to even to 2 decimal places, stored to that same precision; it may not be left empty |

The tool takes no other parameters and no enumerated values.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the reference of the credit record entry created on the project, the amount credited in USD to two decimal places, the day the credit was dated and the project balance after it. That sentence is what indicates the credit was put on; the owner can see the same credit line and the same balance on the project statement.
